[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended bike maintenance tips for hybrid bikes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Check tire pressure weekly (60-80 PSI for hybrid bikes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Ensure quick releases and bolts are securely tightened.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Inspect brake pads for wear and replace when worn down to 1-2 mm.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Lubricate the chain regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Clean the bike regularly with a soft brush, avoiding high-pressure hoses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Check and adjust cables and derailleurs for smooth shifting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Store the bike properly in a dry area away from sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Schedule regular tune-ups with a professional mechanic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Keep a maintenance log to track activities.
